snippet.title: God Save Birmingham - Exclusive Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out this exclusive God Save Birmingham gameplay trailer! Enjoy eight minutes of new farmer-versus-zombies gameplay in God Save Birmingham, the upcoming zombie-apocalypse survival game set in 14th-century Birmingham, England. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073940/God_Save_Birmingham/
